notes:
IPv6 切换更可靠、日志更安全。

## 修复

- **IPv6 热切换在 TUN / fake-ip 模式下真正生效**：此前该模式下切换 IPv6 偏好
  存在「承诺了却没真正重建路由」的情况，现已修正为真实生效，切换后连接行为
  与设置一致。

## 安全

- **`core.log` 现以 0o600 创建并加固存量文件**：日志在 info/debug 级会记录逐连接
  的目的地信息，此前以 0o644 创建，在多用户桌面上任意本地用户可读；现与
  `config.yaml` 一致收紧为仅属主可读，并对升级前的旧文件补做加固。

## 兼容性

账号、订阅、协议、更新签名公钥、各平台升级身份均未改变。
内核基线 mihomo v1.19.30。Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2。
notesEn:
More reliable IPv6 switching, safer logs.

## Fixed

- **IPv6 hot-switch now actually takes effect in TUN / fake-ip mode**: in that
  mode, switching the IPv6 preference previously "promised but did not truly
  rebuild routing"; it now applies for real, so connection behavior matches the
  setting right after you switch.

## Security

- **`core.log` is now created 0o600, and existing files are hardened**: at
  info/debug level the log records per-connection destination lines; it was
  created 0o644, readable by any local user on multi-user desktops. It is now
  owner-only, matching `config.yaml`, and pre-upgrade files are chmod-hardened.

## Compatibility

Accounts, subscriptions, protocols, update-signing keys, and per-platform
upgrade identities are unchanged. Core baseline mihomo v1.19.30.
Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2.
